facts.fact: 叙述者 Beau 说，截至 ten-thirty Saturday morning，哥哥 Jax 已威胁 murder 他 twice、卖掉两人各半的 Jones Automotive once、并把他 stranded 在 Marigold Ranch no fewer than four times。
facts.anchor: By ten-thirty Saturday morning, Jax had threatened to murder me twice, sell our half of Jones Automotive once, and leave me stranded at Marigold Ranch no fewer than four times.

facts.fact: Beau 说他们 shortly after seven 赶到时，Carson 已经在外面，站在 Earl 身旁（靠近一处 pasture），臂下夹着 clipboard、手里端着 coffee cup。
facts.anchor: When we’d pulled up shortly after seven, she’d already been outside, standing beside Earl near one of the pastures with a clipboard tucked beneath her arm and a coffee cup in her hand

facts.fact: Twenty minutes later，Carson 驾着一辆装满 feed 的旧 utility cart 从 Beau 和 Jax 身边驶过。
facts.anchor: Twenty minutes later, she’d driven past us in an old utility cart loaded with feed.

facts.fact: Beau 说 Two days ago 他曾以为 ranch 是因为 Carson 跟不上而 falling apart；他承认自己错了。
facts.anchor: Two days ago, I’d thought the ranch was falling apart because Carson couldn’t keep up with it.

facts.fact: Meme（Evelyn Rome）说自己嫁给 James Rome 长达 forty-three years。
facts.anchor: I was married to James Rome for forty-three years.

facts.fact: 午餐时 Meme 保证没人盘子空着超过 thirty seconds。
facts.anchor: Meme made sure nobody’s plate remained empty for more than thirty seconds.

facts.fact: Jax 把 gloves 扔到 tailgate 上说：若午餐不值至少 fifty dollars 就给 Carson 寄发票。
facts.anchor: If lunch isn’t worth at least fifty dollars, I’m sending her an invoice.

facts.fact: Beau 纳闷 Carson 为何 spent five years protecting a festival barn she refused to enter。
facts.anchor: why she’d spent five years protecting a festival barn she refused to enter
